angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 354,807 km at 102.25 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.7804 +/- 0.0194 mas (same row, RUWE 1.05): 102.25 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.51 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Livingston et al. 2018, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-117 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..277L/abstract): 354,807 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.54 +/- 0.01 solar masses from Livingston et al. 2018, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-117 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..277L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3778 +/- 53 K from Livingston et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-117 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..277L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Livingston et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-117 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..277L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-117.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.755, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-117 (pscomppars): spectral type M1.0 V, from Hirano et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....155..127H/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-117 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.05 dex, from Livingston et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..277L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-117 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.35655, from Hirano et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....155..127H/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 597829077890316928, flags_flame 00: age_flame 12.690801 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 6.9601617 to 13.5)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, K2-117: projected rotation speed 2.91 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2022ApJS..259...35A)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
